name: Goldmeadow
description: Goldmeadow is a walled kithkin village in Lorwyn that Shadowmoor transforms into its night aspect.

status.text: As of the latest recorded event, Goldmeadow has been transformed into its Shadowmoor aspect.

citations.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Brigid lives in Mistmeadow and helps defend it from Ashling the Destroyer.
timeline.quote: Later, Brigid came to live in Mistmeadow and helped to defend the city from Ashling the Destroyer.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unfamiliar world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vigilant Eidren sacrifices himself to hurl Ashling away and save Mistmeadow.
timeline.quote: Mistmeadow was saved only by the sacrifice of Vigilant Eidren, who channeled the power of the Wilt-Leaf forest through his body directly at Ashling and hurled her away.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unfamiliar world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen seeks Ashling's help as Oona's consciousness reasserts itself, bringing news of Isilu and Morcant's plot; they travel to Goldmeadow.
timeline.quote: Ashling was approached by Maralen in her time of crisis

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling and the others fight the Shadowmoor-afflicted kithkin and Gilt-Leaf elves; Rhys catches Maralen and fatally strikes her as their pact demanded.
timeline.quote: Rhys managed to catch up to Maralen and fatally struck her just as their pact had demanded of him.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko reveals he orchestrated the ordeal, falsely convinced Maralen and Rhys of Oona's return, and cures his sister.
timeline.quote: Making amends, he cured his sister, and the two were able to reconcile.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eirdu and Isilu reunite, rebalancing the plane's cycle; Rhys, freed of the pact's magic, dissolves into Eirdu's light.
timeline.quote: Ashling then watched as he dissolved into Eirdu's light.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys strikes Maralen with moonglove; Oko admits he roused Isilu and turned Rhys against her.
timeline.quote: Rhys struck her with the moonglove poison, ensuring her death

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko cures Maralen with dawnglow; Eirdu appears to offset Isilu and Rhys is at peace.
timeline.quote: Oko acquired a vial of dawnglow

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys declines a new oath, bids Maralen farewell, and fades into a shower of petals.
timeline.quote: his form faded beautifully into the wind as a shower of petals from across Lorwyn and Shadowmoor

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Isilu walks past Goldmeadow, plunging it into Shadowmoor, and the students flee toward Glen Elendra.
timeline.quote: Isilu walked past the village, plunging a place that had been in Lorwyn for years into the darkness of Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The students arrive at Goldmeadow and Brigid takes them into the meeting hall, saying her mangled thoughtweft connection makes the locals nervous.
timeline.quote: I make the locals a bit nervous, what with my connection to the thoughtweft all mangled up and half-severed.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The students explain how they arrived; Brigid identifies the creature as a faerie and says she is a close friend of Queen Maralen.
timeline.quote: I'm sort of a close friend of their queen.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The blue faerie reappears in the meeting hall and laughs until alarm bells drown it out, then flies away.
timeline.quote: the little blue faerie from before, which had flown in through a window and was now hovering in front of him.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Isilu walks past Goldmeadow and the darkness transforms the village into its Shadowmoor aspect.
timeline.quote: Everywhere the darkness touched, the city was transformed.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Brigid tells the students to flee and explains how to reach Glen Elendra, warning them not to listen to anyone who begs them to turn around.
timeline.quote: When I step through this door, you run, you understand me?

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The students flee through a village torn between day and night as the shadows swallow the sunlit defenders.
timeline.quote: bit by bit, the archers were falling, transforming into moon-eyed fighters from the other side.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Night-side figures pull Brigid into the darkness, transforming her, and she fights alongside them against her former allies.
timeline.quote: when she opened her eyes again, they were full moon-bright, filled with a light that had nothing to do with the day.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Brigid takes them to Goldmeadow, where Isilu turns the village to Shadowmoor and they flee toward Glen Elendra to seek Maralen.
timeline.quote: Isilu walked past the village, turning a place that had been in Lorwyn for years into Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Abigale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko brings Isilu to Goldmeadow; the town becomes Mistmeadow and Brigid becomes her Shadowmoor self.
timeline.quote: for the first time in her long and storied life, Brigid became her Shadowmoor self.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "Eclipsed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eirdu restores Mistmeadow to Goldmeadow and the kithkin to themselves.
timeline.quote: another student returned, bringing Lorwyn's incarnation, Eirdu , which restored Mistmeadow to Goldmeadow and the kithkin to their former selves.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "Eclipsed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Isilu walks past Goldmeadow, turning it into Shadowmoor; Brigid tells the students to flee toward Maralen's palace.
timeline.quote: Isilu walked past the village, turning a place that had been in Lorwyn for years into Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Kirol", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
